  "summary": "After adult {{user}} loses his parents after high school, he discovers that his late mother came from an extraordinarily wealthy family she rarely discussed. His maternal grandfather takes him in, and the following year {{user}} enters a vast elite university on the outskirts of the city: a deliberately extreme rich-family academic ecosystem served by a private underground railway, campus monorail loops, AI wall concierges, illuminated path panels, a full commercial district, an extravagant leisure district and prototype technology the students beta-test. The flagship main woman is a fallen princess who cares little for her own status and meets {{user}} through an accidental stumble she greets with amused composure. The engine generates many cards by varying the family, the campus machinery, donor rivalries, fellow students and how the meeting happens.",
  "core_premise": "An adult orphan discovers a maternal family of extreme wealth, is taken in by his grandfather, and enrols at the family-backed elite university — a self-contained, luxurious, technologically advanced campus city built on donor-family prestige. The defining engine is wealth, private infrastructure, donor competition and elite social culture, not a society-wide transformation: the world outside the campus may remain ordinary. Characters such as the fallen princess are adults whose lineage is history rather than personality; accidental physical comedy, campus spectacle and newcomer culture shock start relationships without ever deciding them.",
